name: visual-research-board
description: Provider-runtime validation MVP for a source-aware visual research board with broad multi-provider visual retrieval diagnostics, live-key test tooling, Next.js runtime deployment, and GitHub Pages static-demo deployment.

scripts.qa: node tests/qa-check.mjs && node tests/normalization-check.mjs && node tests/e2e-fixture-check.mjs && node tests/provider-smoke-check.mjs && node tests/library-conflict-check.mjs && node tests/broad-retrieval-check.mjs && node tests/retrieval-evidence-check.mjs && node tests/provider-runtime-pack-check.mjs
scripts.test:ci:no-browser: npm run qa && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.validate: npm run qa && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.validate:full: npm run qa && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.validate:deploy: npm run qa && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run build:static
